Context:
- CoreSight turns a photo of a drill core tray into a geotechnical log. Today SAM 3.1 segments each row of core with the noun phrase "stone"; on some photos it finds nothing. Next, Muse Spark will localize the core pieces of each row (boxes in a 0 to 1000 grid) and SAM 3.1 will cut them with box prompts, and the geologist will click the photo to give SAM positive and negative point prompts.
- `sam_prompt` turns `SamObject`s into the `input_text` of a SAM 3.1 box and point prompt. `grid_box_to_pixels` turns a Muse Spark grid box into an inclusive pixel box of the image sent. Both are pure functions: no model calls, no I/O.

final_answer:
Done, with one caveat on verification (below).

## Rules as implemented

`sam_prompt` ([meta_client.py](D:\Repos\coresight\src\coresight\meta_client.py:182)):
- Format: `<0f>` + comma-joined objects in given order; each is `id` + optional box token + point tokens in given order. Box: `<|box;x1=..;y1=..;x2=..;y2=..;w=..;h=..|>`; point: `<|point;x=..;y=..;w=..;h=..|>` with `-` prefix when negative. Same `w,h` in every token.
- Validation (`ValueError`, short message): size must be positive `int` pixels; 1–16 objects (over-limit message reads `at most 16 objects, got N`); id a non-bool `int >= 0`, each once; each object needs a box or a positive point (box + only-negative-points is fine). Floats are floored (`// 1`, so `-0.5` → `-1`, refused); floored box must satisfy `0 <= x1 <= x2 < w`, `0 <= y1 <= y2 < h` (one-pixel boxes OK, inverted/outside refused); every point, positive or negative, must be strictly inside.

`grid_box_to_pixels` ([meta_client.py](D:\Repos\coresight\src\coresight\meta_client.py:229)):
- Same size check, then each grid coordinate scales as `value * n // 1000` (floored, exact for ints), clamps to `[0, n-1]` — so grid `1000` lands on `n` and clamps to the last pixel — and backwards boxes are reordered with min/max, so the result is always a valid inclusive prompt box.

Three small private helpers sit next to them (`_prompt_image_size`, `_prompt_pixel`, `_grid_pixel`); signatures, dataclasses, `MAX_SAM_OBJECTS`, and all other code untouched; no new imports or dependencies. I hand-traced all 22 tests in `tests/test_sam_prompts.py` against the code and each passes.
